about: The five collections that scripts/build_collections.py builds from the flat skills/ folder, each a plugin of its own without hooks, which the release publishes as the collections branch beside the whole set. A skill names its collection in its SKILL.md frontmatter as metadata.category; awaiting_room names it instead while that SKILL.md has no room for the line under 8,000 bytes. A collection's manifests say what it holds, then with_core (every collection but the core), then without. See references/collections.md.

marketplace.name: synthesis-collections
marketplace.description: The synthesis skills in five collections, each a plugin without hooks. The whole set, with the guards, the board and the rituals, is synthesis-skills in the synthesis-engineering marketplace.

with_core: It builds on the core collection: Claude Code installs the core with it, and in Codex and Muse you install both.
without: It has no hooks and no runtime, so no guards, no board and none of the rituals' state: nothing in it checks a send, a deploy or a commit, or coordinates sessions. Where one of its skills describes those, it describes the whole set. The whole set, synthesis-skills, has all of them and every skill: https://github.com/synthesisengineering/synthesis-skills

core.name: synthesis-skills-core
core.description: The ground every synthesis collection stands on: thinking and grounding discipline, verification before done, project records that survive compaction and restarts, decision packets and action sheets, the skill router, the skills that install synthesis and keep skill copies true to their source, and editing a knowledge base in the Open Knowledge Format, which each new workspace starts with.

project-management.name: synthesis-skills-project-management
project-management.description: Project work that outlasts a session: resuming a project in any harness, waiting on a bounded event, running a delegated task to the end, adversarial review rounds, keeping Claude Code, Codex and Muse in step, and capturing what a session learned into a knowledge base and publishing that knowledge base.

engineering.name: synthesis-skills-engineering
engineering.description: Planning, reviewing and shipping code: code planning and architecture decisions, pre-merge gates, code audits, pull request review and triage, codebase reviews, integrating contributions, Bitbucket, the commit check, and setting up local and hosted models as technical help.

writing.name: synthesis-skills-writing
writing.description: Writing, editing and publishing: reader briefings, articles and their refreshes, framing, checks for slop and bad-writing patterns, craft, fact-checking, link research, distribution, voice profiles, clean text and provenance, executive communication, disclosure decisions and a pre-deploy content gate.

chief-of-staff.name: synthesis-skills-chief-of-staff
chief-of-staff.description: The work of a chief of staff and an executive assistant: calendar and meetings, correspondence and its send rules, Slack, inbox and local messages, the daily rituals, absences and catching up after them, quick answers, and keeping your Macs and their repositories in step.
